gotchas: HawaiianMiles is gone: signup is the shared Alaska/Hawaiian Atmos Rewards join form, served on this host at https://www.hawaiianairlines.com/atmosrewards/enroll (same form as alaskaair.com/atmosrewards/enroll). The old /my-account/join-hawaiianmiles URL redirects to the homepage. A 'Pre-Qualify ... Atmos Rewards Card' modal ('No, thanks') and an advisory banner can show on the homepage.
Fields are Auro web components (auro-input / auro-button) in shadow DOM; plain button selectors miss the submit, use auro-button:has-text("Join Atmos Rewards").

Required beyond name/email/password: Gender (custom combobox), Date of birth (Month combobox + Day/Year spinbuttons), phone (country code combobox + input[name="phoneNumber"]; no phone token, type a synthetic number), and a full mailing address (Country, Address line 1, Zip, City, State combobox). Middle name, suffix and preferred airport are optional.

User ID: email or a 7+ character ID with at least 1 letter, no spaces or symbols. Password: 8+ characters with 1 uppercase, 1 lowercase and 1 number. There are two input[type="password"] on the page, so target input[name="password"].
Ad/analytics frames load on the page; a reCAPTCHA Enterprise frame was seen on the identical alaskaair.com form, so expect one here too. Challenge on submit untested.
The marketing email checkbox is pre-checked.
Inputs are hidden under floating labels: click the label text ('First name', 'Phone number', 'User ID', ...) before filling the input by name.
Gender and DOB Month are comboboxes: click, then the role=option ('Female', 'January'). Day and Year are separate inputs. Country code and Country default to United States.
User ID accepts the email address, so the email token can fill it.
Phone is required and takes the national number (no spaces or dashes): fill phone_national. If the identity has no phone, stop; it is an owner step.
2026-10-07 the reCAPTCHA Enterprise badge showed 'ERROR for site owner: Invalid domain for site key'; submit untested.
